fullContentHtml:
SSC Delhi Police Driver Physical Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the Physical Admit Card for the post of Constable Driver on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 660 posts. Applications for the Delhi Police Constable Driver Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 22, 2025, to October 31, 2025. The physical examination is going to conducted on 03 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SSC Delhi Police Driver Physical Admit Card 2026 from the link

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 September 2025
  • Last Date : 15 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 October 2025
  • Online Correction Date : 31 October 2025 to 02 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 16-17 December 2025
  • Self Slot Selection : 05 December 2025 to 10 December 2025
  • Exam City Details : 15 December 2025
  • Admit Card : December 2025
  • Answer Key : 31 December 2025
  • Result : 29 April 2026
  • Final Answer Key & Marks : 26 May 2026
  • Additional Result : 25 June 2026
  • PE & MT Date : 08-09 September 2026
  • Physical Exam On : 03 October 2026
  • Physical Admit Card : 26 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
